QuestInfo.name: Reclaiming the Sacred Stone
QuestInfo.0: Tell #p3000000# what you heard from #p3000001#. You need to reclaim the Sacred Stone.
QuestInfo.1: Angelic Buster says she found the entrance to the Nefarious Priests's hideout at #b#m400010300##k. Go to the hideout, defeat the Nefarious Priests, and recover the Sacred Stone.
QuestInfo.2: You didn't find any trace of the Sacred Stone in the hideout. Maybe it was already moved to another place. Give the hideout another look.
